Package zephyr.wallet.model

Class ZephyrTxQuery

java.lang.Object
zephyr.daemon.model.ZephyrTx
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrTxWallet
zephyr.wallet.model.ZephyrTxQuery
All Implemented Interfaces:
Filter<ZephyrTxWallet>
public class ZephyrTxQuery extends ZephyrTxWallet implements Filter<ZephyrTxWallet>
Configures a query to retrieve transactions. All transactions are returned except those that do not meet the criteria defined in this query.
